## Calculate award timeliness metrics for an individual award, or for an agency or branch.

The SBIR/STTR Policy Directive sets a target for agencies to notify applicants of award decisions within 90 calendar days of the closing date of the solicitation*, and awards should be issued no more than 180 calendar days after the closing date of the solicitation.
